summary: Frontend-only regression test for removal of 'Sumber publik' / source footer from putusan detail. Verified across Tax Knowledge, Tax Database, Putusan detail, Peraturan detail, Compare modal, and Compare page. All checks pass with no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 803 lines long - consider splitting into smaller focused components (DocumentDetail, TaxDatabase, ComparePage, AssistantPanel, etc.) for maintainability.
CSS class .source-footer may still be defined in App.css even though no element uses it; harmless but can be cleaned up.

data-testid='database-putusan-filters' shares the same prefix 'database-putusan-' as item buttons; prefix overlap can trip up [data-testid^=...] selectors in tests. Consider renaming filter container testid (e.g., 'database-filters-putusan').
